# Kernel costs

The operation count of every generated sandwich kernel, per algebra: the fused value path
(`v >> x`), and building the matrix of the map path (`v >> X::slot()`, or
`v.prepare::<X>()`), which then costs one matrix product per object. Regenerated with the
algebras and checked by CI, so a change to the generator that changes any kernel's cost
shows up here, in review. See [performance.md](performance.md) for timings.
